scripts.build:js: pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/frontend-typescript build && pnpm build:wasm && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/bindings-javascript build && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/host-node build
scripts.pack:js: pnpm build:js && mkdir -p dist-packages && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/frontend-typescript exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../dist-packages && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/bindings-javascript exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../dist-packages && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/host-node exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../dist-packages
scripts.test:js: pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/frontend-typescript test && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/bindings-javascript test && pnpm --filter @tcc-engine/host-node test
